gsc/rules/army_rules/Cult Ambush/text:
Condition: your Army Faction GENESTEALER CULTS: starting Resurgence points by battle size
Result:
- Incursion: 6 Resurgence points
- Strike Force: 10 Resurgence points
- Onslaught: 14 Resurgence points
Timing: each destruction of your army's unit
Restriction: every non-CHARACTER model in destroyed unit possessing this ability
Select: optionally spend listed Resurgence points for destroyed unit's Starting Strength, attached CHARACTER models excluded
If spent:
- your army: new unit added in Cult Ambush
- new unit: identical to destroyed unit, CHARACTER models excluded
- new unit: at Starting Strength, all wounds remaining
- new unit's models: equipped [ONE SHOT] weapons considered unshot
- battlefield: 1 Cult Ambush marker placed anywhere >9" horizontally from every enemy unit
- no valid placement: no marker placed

Units in Cult Ambush
Cult Ambush: Strategic Reserves type
**Rapid Ingress** Stratagem: units in Cult Ambush ineligible as targets
Battlefield setup: Cult Ambush marker procedure below, or Strategic Reserves rules on subsequent turn
End of battle round 3: no automatic destruction of units in Cult Ambush

Cult Ambush markers
Circular marker, diameter 32mm
Enemy non-AIRCRAFT model ending any move ≤8" from your placed Cult Ambush marker: marker removed from battlefield
End of opponent's next Movement phase: each of your Cult Ambush markers remaining on battlefield permits optional selection of 1 of your army's units in Cult Ambush for ingress move
That ingress move: at least 1 selected-unit model in base contact with marker
Other selected-unit models: wholly within 3" of marker
After setup: marker removed from battlefield
This rule: ingress move permitted for units in Cult Ambush during battle round 1
